verdict.rationale: The managed Zep product is cloud-first: the quick start installs `zep-cloud`, and the only deployment options listed are Cloud or Your VPC. Local operation comes only through the separate open-source Graphiti framework, which the docs say can "build and query a single Context Graph per subject locally," and its feature set is narrower than full Zep. Missing for 10: evidence of running against local LLMs or embedding models, any documented in-process or embedded storage backend, and confirmation that the local path has no cloud dependency at all.
